limitations: Uniform individual-based rarefaction without replacement; positive integer species counts; one-unit balancing transfer. Lower-bound census exhaustive only through eight individuals. Persistent-family sign assertions refer to sample sizes 2,3,7. A relevant classical variance paper is accessible only in abstract; equivalent work elsewhere remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Originality applies to sign reversals and sharp size threshold for variance under a unit abundance-balancing transfer, not to the classical formulas for hypergeometric rarefaction moments. Exact finite enumeration and rational polynomial coefficients supplied. No empirical validation or independent audit claimed.
title: Two variance reversals under one-unit abundance balancing: a sharp eight-individual threshold and an unbounded family
